# Journey & game design

[Wiki home](README.md) | [Edit source](../../AGENTS.md)

## Gameplan (2026-10-13, from issue #72; design reference since 2026-10-17: `Assets/Design/DESIGN.md`)

The game is now a **journey home**: a moon mission (*SELENE-4*) on its return flight to Earth (the family watches it live on the news, #109) is swallowed by an anomaly/wormhole, the crew wakes in M33 and flies through 5 Local Group galaxies (M33 -> M31 -> NGC 6822 -> Leo I -> LMC) home to Sol, upgrading the **warp drive** (Mk I-V, Home Drive) to shrink the **Home ETA**. Travel = flown warp flights (#73). Death = time loop back to M33 with meta kept (#74, #86); **planned (2026-10-17): #132 replaces it with a system loop** (down/revive, solo emergency cryo, crew wipe = the current system loops back to its arrival checkpoint, same layout, rerolled enemies/loot). Gameplay core planned in #128 (galaxy missions: signals, orbital scan, coordinate fragments -> drive core), #129 (expeditions: drill, salvage, ruin, per-planet alert level), #130 (every pilot flies their own ship inside the warp bubble, multi-seat = gunner/engineer), #131 (drive variants with trade-offs). Enemies: nature + aliens only (no pirates); Wardens = alien guardian species (#42). Collapse -> the Rift (finale only). Credits -> Salvage (`NetInventory.Salvage`), Stardust -> Memory fragments (`Meta.Data.Memories`), done in #112.
- **Gameplay decisions follow `Assets/Design/DESIGN.md` "Gameplan: The Journey Home" and the open issues in roadmap #53, not the legacy code** (#72, the original gameplan issue, is closed; "part of #72" in issues is history). #46 (run structure: 5 galaxies, systems, galaxy map, suspend save; gates/Collapse removed) is in. #73 is split into #78 (crew warp drive), #79 (flown warp), #80 (cruise, hops) and #81 (finale), all done. #74 is split into #86 (time loop, done), #87 (prologue: playable return flight from the Moon, anomaly, waking in M33), #109 (story intro: family watching the news, TV -> cockpit, "SIGNAL LOST"), #88 (homecoming: Sol, landing on Earth, closing news scene, credits), #132 (system loop) and #89 (lore), in that order (sub-issues of #74). #49 is now only the home ship *Nostos* (the SELENE-4 mission ship, built from the Ark); small ships moved to #113. #108 (done) replaced the warp button/countdown: every hop and galaxy warp starts seamlessly by flying out of a jump zone at the system edge (Galactic Rim + skip zone only in a galaxy's outermost system). The flight home from the LMC is the finale with the Rift chase (#81); still legacy until their issues land: the homecoming result screen instead of the Earth/Moon approach and landing (#88), the intro cinematic in a player's first loop instead of the prologue (#87) and pirates (#51). The home ship *Nostos* is in (#49). Energy Cells are gone (#78: Exotic Matter, item id `exotic`).
- Design + glossary (DE design term / EN UI term / code name) + names: `Assets/Design/DESIGN.md` "Gameplan: The Journey Home". Old code names stay until the issue that migrates a system renames it; new code uses the glossary names (`GalaxyDef`, `HomeEta`, `AlertLevel`, `Salvage`, `ExoticMatter`, `Rift`, `Memories` ...). UI language stays English.
